text: Battery rooms shall be ventilated by two exhaust fans of 100 % capacity (duty / standby, 3,000 m3/h each per the equipment records) discharging directly to the outside at a safe location at least 1.5 m above the roof and away from air intakes; the air flow shall keep the hydrogen concentration below 1 vol % (25 % of the LEL of 4 vol %) at the maximum charging current calculated per EN 50272-2, and the required airflow shall be verified for the final battery type and capacity from the battery datasheet.
